question: Select the correct statement with reference to group Angiosperm.

options.text: Angiosperms are also called non-flowering plants.
It is a minor group of kingdom Plantae having only 300 species.
It is the largest and most diverse group in the kingdom Plantae.

solution:
The correct answer is** "It is the largest and most diverse group in the kingdom Plantae".** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Angiosperms** are also called** flowering plants.**
 
• These have about **three lakh species** of flowering plants.
 
• These are **seed-producing plants** and have flowers and produce fruits that contain seeds.
 
• These are vascular plants having roots, stems, and leaves.
 
• Angiosperms are classified into **monocotyledons and dicotyledons.**
 
• **Examples of angiosperms -** Fruits like mango, apple, and banana; grains like corn, rice, and wheat; flowers like roses, Lillies, etc.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** There are five biological kingdoms given by Robert Whittaker:**

 
 
• Kingdom Monera - it consists of prokaryotes like* E.coli*.
 
• Kingdom Protista - *Amoeba*, *Paramecium*, *Euglena*.
 
• Kingdom Fungi - It consists of yeasts, molds, and mushrooms.
 
• Kingdom Plantae - These are photosynthetic eukaryotes.
 
• Kingdom Animalia - Multicellular eukaryotic organisms. 
 
 
 
• **Kingdom Plantae** includes all the plants - eukaryotic, multicellular, and autotropic organisms.
 
• This kingdom is further divided into further sub-groups:
 
 
• Thallophyta
 
• Bryophyta
 
• Pteridophyta
 
• Gymnosperms
 
• Angiosperms
